kitEvidence.formula:
Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to any enemies it hits.

Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing [20 / 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.
